## Pinned designer resources

Selected Open Design resources are pinned at [53231d40b778d88eba23f35547bf99485d3ae9fc](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/tree/53231d40b778d88eba23f35547bf99485d3ae9fc). Its Apache-2.0 license is retained in packages/daemon/resources/designer/OPEN_DESIGN_LICENSE. Individual upstream MIT notices are retained beside their skills and references.
